text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As summer camp comes to an end, I<n>ask Super
Creek how she feels about<n>her summer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I had a really pleasant time. My mind<n>felt completely
free, unlike last year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not having a single worry really is<n>wonderful. It
means we can focus on<n>other things.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We can squint our eyes beneath the<n>harsh sun
above as we walk towards<n>a brighter future, slowly
working<n>together day by day...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, speaking of which... have you<n>gotten a little tan,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh. Awww, it's like you're<n>growing up right
before my very<n>eyes. You're not a fledgling trainer
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I bet other Umamusume will be<n>latching onto you
now too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just remember—wandering off with<n>other
Umamusume just because they<n>ask you to is a big
no-no!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We've got to keep our eyes on the<n>fall G1 series,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Duly reminded, I resolve to buckle<n>down and work
towards the autumn<n>Tenno Sho.
